title: ControlPlaneSuiteResult
description: The gate-result contract (SPEC §14.1): what a test command run by `ccp suite run` may write to the path in CCP_SUITE_RESULT. When written, its numbers are the run's record; otherwise ccp reads the output with plane.json suite.count_re and suite.summary. Only the counters and the failure ids are read; failure ids are shown in the run's summary, never recorded. Anything else is ignored.

tests.description: Tests that ran in this run (not those served from a cache).

ran.description: For a product with a test cache: units run, in the product's unit (tests, modules, files).

cached.description: Units whose result the product's cache served on identical inputs, which count as run (verify.accept_cache).

cached_tests.description: The tests behind the cached units, from their last runs.

failed.description: Failing tests; defaults to the length of failures.

seconds.description: The gate's own timing. Informative: the record keeps ccp's wall time.

stages.description: SPEC §14.2: set by ccp, not the command, for a lane plane.json names: each stage that ran, in order. A command's own value is ignored.

proven_skips.description: SPEC §14.2: set by ccp, not the command, on the gate role's staged lane: each stage a declared prover (plane.json verify.provers) skipped, with the prover's name, its declared command (absent from the ledger event) and its exit code. Absent when none was skipped. A command's own value is ignored.

failed_stage.description: SPEC §14.2: set by ccp: the stage whose non-zero exit stopped the run, the first stage a signal kept from starting, or null.

cold.description: SPEC §14.6: set by ccp, not the command: true when the run counted nothing cached (cached 0), false when any unit was cached, null when it gave no cached count. A command's own value is ignored.
